key_provisions.current_value: Amends Ala. Code Sections 40-9B-3, 40-9B-4, 40-9B-4.1, and 40-23-35. Limits data processing center abatement periods beginning 2027-01-01, generally to 20 years, with added 10-year extension paths for certain investments. Requires certain 100 MW-plus data processing centers to pay state noneducational ad valorem taxes and sales/use tax on specified construction, power, backup generation, and battery purchases beginning 2027-01-01, subject to targeted-county gubernatorial authority. Extends the data processing center abatement sunset.
key_provisions.recommended_value: Amends Alabama data-processing-center tax abatements and sales-tax distribution. For qualifying abatements granted on or after January 1, 2027, revised duration tiers generally permit up to 20 years, with a conditional additional 10 years for qualified local investments. For centers with at least 100 MW peak demand, specified state noneducational ad valorem and construction-related transaction tax abatements generally end when property is placed in service, subject to eligible equipment and targeted-county gubernatorial exceptions. Extends the incentive application sunset and excludes specified incentives in projects executed before the effective date and expansions of those projects during the following ten years from the amendments to Sections 40-9B-3, 40-9B-4 and 40-9B-4.1. Act effective June 1, 2026.
